fundamental_growth_rs.description: accepted SEC Companyfacts Fundamental Growth RS default-off paper

backtest_protocol.execution_model: Existing accepted allocator source rows are rebuilt through the accepted helper. Fundamental Growth RS rows are generated from the existing shared daily candidate builder and converted to fixed $4,000 next-open/10-trading-day paper trades in this runner.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only Fundamental Growth RS source-family extension over the accepted helper source-priority allocator

hypothesis: candidate-pool/allocation alpha: accepted SEC Companyfacts Fundamental Growth RS rows may add a fundamental-quality source to the accepted source-priority allocator, filling dates where OHLCV/event/revision helpers are absent.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by changing Fundamental Growth RS source rank, Companyfacts thresholds, RS thresholds, allocator top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs forward allocator displacement rows, a materially different free data field, or a shared historical/daily Companyfacts allocator helper that changes evidence timing rather than source priority retuning.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The standalone Companyfacts+RS sleeve remains accepted, but its rows did not add enough incremental replacement value after the accepted allocator's higher-priority rows and same-ticker cooldown. The likely failure mode is overlap/displacement plus stale fundamental-row timing, not a defect in the original standalone Companyfacts helper.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate-pool/allocation alpha: accepted SEC Companyfacts Fundamental Growth RS rows may add a fundamental-quality source to the accepted source-priority allocator, filling dates where OHLCV/event/revision helpers are absent.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-017: Accepted Fundamental Growth RS low-liability support. Strong versus core, modest +0.2220 EV / +$2,637.02 versus its prior accepted Companyfacts comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-006: Rejected quality-gated Fundamental Growth RS top-1 replacement: the standalone source improved versus core but failed versus the current accepted Companyfacts stack.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-014: Current accepted allocator with revision source: aggregate EV +0.9720 and PnL +$15,197.05. This is the binding comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-016: Rejected post-earnings allocator source extension because it did not beat the accepted allocator comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-018: Rejected semiconductor basket breadth thrust despite positive aggregate because old_thin and concentration were weak.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Must improve aggregate EV/PnL, have no EV/PnL regression windows, satisfy sample/survival/drawdown/concentration guards, and beat exp-20260610-014 aggregate and per-window EV/PnL comparator. A pass is only a replay lead until shared helper parity is implemented.

prediction.confidence_reason: Companyfacts Fundamental Growth RS has one accepted low-liability support experiment and production-visible default-off daily fields, but exp-20260609-006 showed quality-gated replacement can reject top winners, while recent allocator source extensions often failed by displacing better accepted rows. Low rank-8 insertion limits harm yet makes success unlikely unless fundamental rows appear on dates where higher-priority accepted sources are absent.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing Companyfacts or OHLCV rows create rejected source candidates only
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes in this scout
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: existing Fundamental Growth RS liquidity/trend gates plus next-open/10-trading-day fixed-notional paper conversion
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation envelope pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. It rebuilds accepted helper source rows in a replay runner and adds Fundamental Growth RS rows from the existing shared daily candidate builder. A positive result requires shared allocator helper, daily snapshot wiring, and parity tests before retention.
